name: Native AWQ K32 matrix phase proof checkpoint
body:
Independent native AWQ FP16 adaptation: staging and both native K16 matrix passes for any valid K32 tile.

The unchanged complete source is bound in four N64/N128 instances. Lean proves every scalar operand load, all 64 lane visits, convergence at each matrix instruction, and all 8/16 native MFMA instructions for one K32 iteration. All 256 results per instruction are computed from the old A/B/C register snapshot before any update. Unprocessed accumulator banks are preserved until their own instruction. Both half passes execute with the original warp9/17 fuel, producing dot_half1 + (dot_half0 + C) in source order. The actual K/output continuation remains explicit.

Fresh source checks and a standalone replay without Git or owned compiled caches each pass 525 axiom audits: 49 owned modules, 461 library and 64 source audits. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur. Six changed complete sources fail on false source identity. Forty-four fully rehashed scope controls fail before extraction, including an invented all-K matrix scope. All 47 AWQ Lean resources match the built wheel. The prior block-staging archive replays with its original 418 audits and 35 controls.

The attached archive is byte-identical to the independently replayed source archive. Every new module retains maxRecDepth=10000 and maxHeartbeats=2000000; source kernels, shape bounds and all original machine fuels are unchanged. There are no new GPU launches or model calls. The earlier paired AMD numerical study retains 120 launches and 820,224 CPU float64 comparisons, with zero tolerance failures and zero host bit differences.

The K counter/back edge, full K loop, output stores, whole-launch termination, actual whole-trace race freedom and dense exact-real reference equality remain unfinished. AWQ source certificates: 0; accepted independent production families: eight. This does not reproduce the authors' exact adapted PTX, original model/token outcomes, NVIDIA measurements or IEEE rounding behavior. Full repository CI is tracked separately; main was advanced to the preceding whole-block checkpoint only after all 17 source CI jobs passed.
